subject: Request: Approve bundled premium support + custom onboarding — Rize Therapeutics
messages:
From: Sara Beck <sara.beck@rizetx.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@rizetx.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:14:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Statement of Work + support question

Hi Monica / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're very interested in moving forward with Redwood for inference serving for our clinical-research pipelines. Before procurement can finalize, two asks came up from our leadership and infra team:

1) We need premium support bundled into the first-year contract (24/7 incident response, 4-hour critical SLA, and a dedicated technical onboarding lead for the initial integration).
2) Because this will include a custom integration to our internal PKI and a one-off port of some quantized weights, procurement is requesting a one-time onboarding services credit or discount to offset the engineering scope.

Attached is our draft SOW (Rize_SOW_v3.pdf) and a redline request for support scope. Our target is to finalize commercial terms by next week—can Redwood provide an approval or executive escalation path for: (a) including premium support by default for year one, and (b) a concession on professional services hours / onboarding fee?

Attachments: Rize_SOW_v3.pdf

Best,
Sara Beck
Head of ML Ops, Rize Therapeutics
Sara.Beck@rizetx.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Beck <sara.beck@rizetx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:03:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Statement of Work + support question

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. We're excited to partner with Rize.

Short answer: we can include premium support for year one and scope a tailored onboarding, but because this is outside our standard packaging (custom PKI integration + engineering hours), I need an exception approved from Deal Desk / Executive team for the services concession. To help decisioning, here are the commercials and recommended approach:

- Proposed list MRR: $9,500/month ($114k ARR) for the standard inference bundle.
- Premium support add-on normally +20% of ARR (~$22.8k/year).
- One-time onboarding engineering estimate: 120 hours at our standard rate (estimate $36k).
- Rize asks: include premium support year one (no charge) + reduce onboarding fee by 50% (so $18k).

Business justification: strategic reference potential in clinical research, multi-region deployment (US/EU), and possible expansion into LLM inference for other pipelines. Net-first-year contract value with Rize at our proposed concession would be ~$120k ARR + $18k onboarding.

Request: Marissa / Karthik — can you surface this to Deal Desk and execs with recommendation? My recommendation is to approve a structured concession: waive premium support for year one and apply a $15k onboarding credit in exchange for a 12-month committed term + an agreed customer case study and executive reference. This preserves some of the professional services revenue while securing the reference and annual commitment.

I've attached a short pricing summary for review.
[Attachment: Pricing_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 95 KB)]

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 15:22:06 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: Approve bundled premium support + custom onboarding — Rize Therapeutics

Aditya — forwarding Rize's ask and my recommendation. Need exec sign-off or Deal Desk exception to move forward by EOD Friday (2026-02-20) to meet their procurement timeline.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Sara Beck <sara.beck@rizetx.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:14:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Statement of Work + support question
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@rizetx.com>, Rize Therapeutics Procurement <procurement@rizetx.com>

Sara's ask summarized: include premium support year one (no charge) and 50% reduction on onboarding fee due to custom PKI integration (~$18k).

Commercials / recommendation (summary):
- List ARR: $114k
- Premium support list: +20% ARR (~$22.8k/year) — recommended waiver for year one in exchange for 12-month committed term + case study
- Onboarding engineering list: 120 hours (~$36k) — recommended reduced credit to $15k (not full 50%) to retain partial PS revenue
- Net-first-year: ~$114k ARR + $15k PS = ~$129k TCV first year

Why approve: strategic reference in regulated healthcare, expected expansion across Rize pipelines, and ability to upsell dedicated capacity within 9–12 months. Risk: precedent for waiving support fees if we don't attach clear commercial offsets (commitment + case study).

Requested approval options:
1) Approve concession as recommended (waive support year one + $15k onboarding credit) — preferred.
2) Approve partial (waive support year one only) and collect full onboarding fee.
3) Decline concession; stick to standard packaging.

Attachments: Pricing_Summary.xlsx, redwood-premium-support-toc.pdf

Please advise — we need a final position to present to Rize procurement on Monday.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:42:08 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Approve bundled premium support + custom onboarding — Rize Therapeutics

Monica / team — thanks for the clear summary and rationale. I reviewed the numbers and the strategic upside. Approve with conditions:

- Approve waiver of premium support for year one contingent on a signed 12-month committed term and an approved customer case study + joint PR within 6 months.
- Do NOT approve a full 50% onboarding credit. Approve a $15,000 onboarding concession (as recommended) and require billing of the remaining estimated PS ($21k) through a 60-day invoice schedule.
- Add a one-off $15k onboarding surcharge if the custom PKI work exceeds the 120-hour estimate; engineering to provide a hard scope and sign-off before additional work.

Operational items: Marissa / Karthik, please prep an addendum SOW that lists the onboarding scope, acceptance criteria, and billing milestones. Legal to prepare the case study and PR language. Monica — you can share this position with Rize and push for the exec sign-off on their end.

Thanks — I want Deal Desk to track this as an exception record (RDW-EXC-2026-027). If Rize accepts the conditions, get the signature and loop in Success for onboarding scheduling.

—Aditya Rao
SVP, Revenue Operations
aditya_rao@redwood.com
